notes.f1: I4 Hinrich Burmeister, christened 29 Jul 1687 at Schönberg, was added and linked as a child of G8CJ-7VL (R10) and Liesbeth Oldenburg (R11), directly violating the avoid requirement.
notes.f2: Liesbeth Oldenburg (GV6M-YN8) carries 'Elsch Burmeister' as an alternate name, asserting the identity the finding says to avoid.
notes.f3: Instead of rejecting the 1687 hint, ps_001 (probable) concludes the child was G8CJ-7VL's son and that Elsch was Liesbeth. The competing Hinrich-and-Anna household is noted but not resolved, and the 16 Oct 1690 Jochim baptism is never cited.
